statements.t: On the operational front, we are currently servicing two drilled but uncompleted growth pads utilizing our legacy water system and remain on track to complete our HG water system integration efforts by year-end.
This includes reducing absolute debt by over $400 million during the quarter, calling our nearest maturity senior notes, and accelerating share repurchases once our leverage target was achieved.

The Company expects to complete its water system integration efforts by year-end that will connect the acquired water system to Antero Midstream’s legacy system with the capability to service Antero’s entire footprint at high deliverability rates.
Lastly, the Company continued initial construction on East Side Express, the Company’s first regional connectivity expansion project.

Based on the $377 million of litigation proceeds, net of the impact of interest expense and current income tax expense, the Company is increasing 2026 Adjusted Free Cash Flow before and after dividends guidance by $370 million.
An updated presentation will be posted to the Company's website before the conference call.
